Research Engineer in NMR spectroscopy working on development of methods based on 1D and 2D NMR sequences for metabolomic projects in the field of food toxicology. 

## Education

**Ph.D** in chemistry in 1999

## Experience

**INRAE – Toxalim Laboratory** in Toulouse (31) as Research Engineer in NMR spectroscopy for Metabolomics, metabolomics facility manager since 2023 (2001 – present)

**University of Oklahoma – Chemistry Service** Norma (USA) as Research Chemist in NMR of liquid crystals (1999-2000)
